notes: Example inspects one explicitly configured PEM certificate on Unix or the LocalMachine My certificate store on Windows. Edit the Unix path before running. Does not reproduce the built-in bounded directory search.

commands.linux:
# Standalone example: Example inspects one explicitly configured PEM certificate on Unix or the LocalMachine My certificate store on Windows. Edit the Unix path before running. Does not reproduce the built-in bounded directory search.
# Set this to a public certificate file; do not point it at a private key.
certificate=/etc/ssl/certs/example.pem
openssl x509 -in "$certificate" -noout -subject -issuer -enddate
commands.darwin:
# Standalone example: Example inspects one explicitly configured PEM certificate on Unix or the LocalMachine My certificate store on Windows. Edit the Unix path before running. Does not reproduce the built-in bounded directory search.
# Set this to a public certificate file; do not point it at a private key.
certificate=/etc/ssl/cert.pem
openssl x509 -in "$certificate" -noout -subject -issuer -enddate
